items.title: What Is Corning (GLW) Doing In 3D Cell Culture And Cell Harvesting?
items.summary: Corning (NYSE:GLW) is cited as a key leader in global 3D cell culture and automated cell harvesting markets. The company's technologies are being used to improve drug discovery workflows and biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes. Corning's work in 3D cell culture and automated cell harvesting could broaden its role in the life sciences sector.
